name: Marshal McBride
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Marshal McBride commands Stormwind's garrison and defends the valley. Kobolds threaten its farms and mines, so he directs new recruits against them.

sections.title: Commander of Northshire
sections.body: Marshal McBride commands Stormwind's garrison outside Northshire Abbey. The abbey is a place of faith and learning, while unrest across the kingdom has left military garrisons short of soldiers. With only a handful of sworn guards, McBride must keep the valley peaceful and protect its food and resources. Green recruits arrive seeking training from the abbey's masters, and he must put them to work.

sections.title: The Kobold Incursion
sections.body: Kobolds have grown more aggressive around Northshire. Once a nuisance, they have spread through the woods and seized Echo Ridge Mine, an important local resource. Short of regular soldiers, McBride calls on paladins, warriors, and other novices to drive back the tunneling kobolds and learn how far the infestation reaches before the valley is cut off.

faq.answer: Marshal McBride commands Stormwind's garrison at Northshire Abbey. He defends Northshire Valley and directs new recruits into service.

faq.q: Why is McBride having recruits fight kobolds?
faq.answer: Kobolds have overrun the woods around Northshire and seized Echo Ridge Mine. With Stormwind's forces stretched thin, McBride sends newly arrived adventurers to drive them out and secure the area.

faq.q: Where does McBride send recruits next?
aliases: where do i go after mcbride
faq.answer: After a recruit has handled the threats in Northshire Valley, McBride sends them south along the road to Goldshire to help Marshal Dughan.
Echo Ridge Mine is a mineral-rich cavern on the northern edge of Northshire Valley. Kobolds have overrun it, and McBride has ordered several efforts to reclaim it.

faq.q: Does McBride command the abbey itself?
aliases: who is in charge of the abbey
faq.answer: No. Northshire Abbey is maintained by the holy orders and priests of the Light. McBride commands the military garrison defending the abbey and the surrounding valley.

faq.q: Is McBride concerned about threats beyond kobolds?
faq.answer: Kobolds are McBride's most immediate concern, but bandits and outlaws linger at the valley's edges, signs of wider unrest across Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: As a human beginning in Northshire, you first meet Marshal McBride, Stormwind's royal authority in the valley.
As a warrior, you can serve the kingdom by helping McBride clear kobolds from Echo Ridge's tunnels.
As an Alliance recruit, you begin at the Grand Alliance's frontier in humanity's heartland, where McBride brings recruits into the Crown's service.
